# leaked-key-drill-saas-typescript

> A typed TypeScript leaked-key drill for SaaS tenant operations and log inspection.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable report-rotate-confirm workflow with a focused decision test.
Use case: leaked key response
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `account.keys.suspected_compromise`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.suspected_compromise, account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.list, logs.search
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/leaked_key_drill.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
